new_text: The only room in the Lab with a rug. On the desk, a journal in a neat, slanted hand, and a child's drawing: 'For Papa, from {rescuer}.' The last entry is ten years old.
Siphon is {rescuer}'s father. He held the door.
You came back for me. Down there, on purpose. I'm going to need a while to stop being cross about it.
You wore my face for ten years and never once learned to taste. Today you start. Let me give you something to start with.
Moss Mulligan hops up from the bank. "You got Billie's herd home? The goat, the pig AND the raccoon? Then the stream owes you a bridge."
Moss Mulligan tucks her hands behind her back. "Sorry! I only grow bridges for people who have helped the herd, and Billie Muckfoot's animals have got out again.
Round them up for Billie, then come back to me, and I will grow you a way across. No thorns. Promise."
Moss Mulligan grows this one for anyone who helps Billie Muckfoot round up the herd.
The herd's home and it's plotting. Thanks! Moss Mulligan at the centre bridge will grow you a crossing now. Tell her I sent you.
Shirt number two hundred and twelve. Very proud of it. Notice my form?
The last guard before the Model Room: a warden whose job is to keep everyone away from the table. (Elite)
The Model Room
The Model Room is round and domed, and in its centre stands a table the size of a house: a perfect miniature of {kingdom}.
At half health a reserve guard steps off a pedestal: a 1/1 Reserve Guard joins.
Nugget
Big Lou
PELL FAMILY PARLOUR
The deceased are asked to remain in their parlours until a permit has been approved. Please do not wander.
Widow Pell's husband has sat in the family parlour for three years because his burial permit loops forever. It needs the Stamp of Final Approval, somewhere in Grave Row.
Attention, citizens. (a cough) The weather is no longer approved. It is just weather. It seems to be managing.
The Alchemist's cauldron now takes three Paths at once: brew their essence into a tri-Path card.
